selection: Final native source only. Retired trial tables/rows from moderate, compact, paced and the earlier durable table are intentionally excluded.

timingAssumptions.excluded: Network latency and navigation outside the declared native action model. Execution CPU time is not player time.

conditions.phase: native phaseFor(level): level20 phase1, level55 phase5; both are at their current level cap
conditions.recoveryTrigger: Any party member dead or below 50% HP
conditions.recoveryActions: Native MOVE to inn, PLACE_ENTER, BUY, native MOVE back; travel encounters use native combat and enter totals

limitations: Single seed 717 in the final full elemental screening and target completions; retired candidate exploration additionally used 4242 but is not counted as final-source verification.
Reference ownership/equipment/level/story gates are synthetic declared conditions. The reports are not measured phone/network latency or all team strategies.
Mature screening is twelve continuous wins per stage, not a perpetual sustainability guarantee. Target rows actually complete their full stated material goal.
Some neighboring intermediate levels can vary with enemy formation/skill animation; the practical upper-stage comparison is against the best measured lower stage.

The native material table and ascension/talent demand are unchanged. Faster material farming is only one component of the broader XP, Mora, equipment, specialty, boss and monster-material cultivation budget.

postPricingFixVerification.method: Pricing-only zero-lodging-path review plus native twelve-battle prefix replay of every final target campaign. Original full campaigns were not rerun.
postPricingFixVerification.replayedFields: Enemy source/HP/ATK/DEF, persistent party HP, PRNG, victory, rounds, deaths, materials, presentation/input durations and modeled seconds.
postPricingFixVerification.conclusion: All original 208 campaign totals remain unchanged: none executes the sole changed pricing operation. Current-source native prefix regressions match exactly; original simulation hashes and counts are preserved.
